summary: Build three battle-resolution timing primitives (Before This Battle Resolves, After This Battle Resolves, province-destroyed-during-resolution) in MatchEngine.cs, and wire the first three real cards to use them: Encircled Terrain, Looting the Ruins, Vital Pathways (Strategy wave 10, 320 wired). Crosses into src/L5R.Client/Content/Published/ only to add the three new cards' own scanned art (oracle-l5r-2332.jpg, oracle-l5r-10742.jpg, oracle-l5r-10403.jpg), the same routine art-only cross every prior wave's handoff already makes -- no client code or UI behavior touched. Also fixes a real, unrelated pre-existing bug in tools/env.sh (an unguarded Godot-discovery glob silently exited tools/check.sh with zero output on any machine with no Godot editor installed, including a plain --skip-client run).
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests (230/230: 173 core + 57 published, including 4 new regression tests for the three primitives) and bash tools/check.sh --skip-client (all four .NET test projects plus both Python unittest suites) both green. docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx regenerated (320 wired, 3 stale BLOCKERS entries removed).
